Resolve strict owner-local codec/digest validation or another proven owner contract before activating amendment persistence. Preserve old bytes, old fact hashes and historical readers; no foreign private-table access.

Append-only FORCE-RLS immutable amendment table and exact server-derived anchor from unchanged original row including actor/time; private actor/company/key lookup binds business request, excludes key/correlation from public receipt.

Authorized committed replay precedes fresh admission/MFA, current evidence and external I/O. Fresh path checks stored complete head, retained RF withdrawal, independently captured current replacement with equivalent event/date/economics, exact retained Documents and Ledger assertion on same connection/company lock.

Verify signed original documents, memo and replacement RF originals outside company locks. Their metadata is established at amendment time, not retroactively frozen. Final SQL checks exact complete coverage via public Documents assertion; no caller verified Boolean or subset-only trust.

Mint amendment identity/time server-side after locks; capture must predate cutoff. Use strict SQL/Python canonical byte/hash parity, not jsonb::text as a substitute. Preserve original event/facts/finalization/Ledger/Banking/timestamps.

Publish additive complete-chain enumeration and actor-bound exact-key recovery with unavailable-versus-not-observed distinction. No Ledger posting, reversal or Banking claim. Actual RLS, owner/MFA races, competing heads/keys, direct SQL bypass and retained replay require runtime proof.

Consume additive Governance original+complete-chain projection, keeping old unamended capture-time rule and old codecs. Amended replacement uses amendment timestamp and binds head id/digest with original economic/finalization commitments.
Version source/receipt/archive commitments additively and recheck effective binding at consequential admission. Later withdrawal/amendment invalidates fresh use without erasing historical receipts.
